section.title: Intended Audience
section.p: This customization guide helps integrators and system administrators find information about integrating and customizing .
For information about using the application, see the Oxygen XML Web Author User Guide.

section.title: Introduction
section.p: A main benefit of is that it can integrate with your existing content ecosystem, allowing anyone in your organization to access content wherever they have an internet connection. is highly versatile and can be customized to work with any XML vocabulary and file repository system. It uses the same extension points, frameworks, options, and plugins as the standalone version of Oxygen XML Editor/Author.
Depending on your requirements, you may need to integrate with several components. The complexity of the integration can range from simple configuration to developing custom extensions with the API.

section.title: Integration with File Storage Systems
section.p: If you want your content contributors to be able to open and save files, you need to integrate with your file storage system. For example, it can be integrated into a CMS or a versioning control system.

section.title: Integration with a User Management System
section.p: You can also integrate with a user management system. This allows you to manage permissions and authentication, display the name of the user in comments and tracked changes, or customize the interface according to a user profile.

section.title: Integration in a CMS or Another Web Application
section.p: Web Author can be integrated as an embedded XML editor in your Content Management System or another web application. You can also customize the Web Author interface using the JavaScript API.

section.title: Integrate Web Author in Your Workflow
section.p: can be configured to launch from an embedded link (for example, a link that appears in a web page, email message, or published output). You can also control the workflow by embedding a custom action in the toolbar or contextual menu (for example, an action to check a file in/out or mark a reviewed file as being resolved).

section.title: Customizing Web Author for Your Content
section.p: There are various ways to customize Web Author to meet your structured-content requirements:

ul.li: Web Author supports any XML schema in any schema language. It also provides built-in support for DITA, DocBook, TEI, and XHTML.
Customized frameworks can be reused interchangeably between Oxygen XML Editor/Author and .
supports inline form controls, making it easier to edit complex XML structures.
You can impose business rules through Schematron validation and quick fixes. For more information, see the Schematron Quick Fixes (SQF) section in the Oxygen XML Editor User Manual.
includes automatic spell checking, and you can customize the words it detects by adding custom dictionaries. Web Author also supports third-party solutions for checking grammar.

When customizing a framework in Oxygen XML Editor/Author, you can create custom document templates. After you upload the framework to Web Author, users can access the templates when creating a new document.
can be customized with a variety of plugin types or by using the Java or JavaScript API.
You can customize various options that are shared by and Oxygen XML Editor/Author. This allows you to configure a consistent editing experience for all users.
